spans.s: बकः [bakḥ], 1 The Indian crane; न प्रयत्नशतेनापि शुकवत् पाठ्यते बकः H.
A cheat, rogue, hypocrite (the crane being a very cunning bird that knows well how to draw others into its clutches).
N. of a demon killed by Bhīma.
N. of another demon killed by Kṛiṣṇa.
N. of Kubera.
An apparatus for subliming metals or minerals. -की = पूतना q. v. अहो बकी यं स्तनकालकूटं जिघांस- यापाययदप्यसाध्वी

A female crane.-Comp. -चरः, -वृत्तिः, -व्रतचरः, -व्रतिकः, -व्रतिन् m. 'acting like a crane', a false devotee, religious hypocrite; अधोदृष्टिर्नैष्कृतिकः स्वार्थसाधनतत्परः । शठो मिथ्याविनीतश्च बकव्रतचरो द्विजः ॥
. -चिञ्चिका, -चिञ्ची a kind of fish.-जित् m., -निषूदनः epithets of
Bhīma.

of Kṛiṣṇa.-धूपः a kind of perfume. -पञ्चकम् the last five days of the bright half of the month of Kārtika (during which even the heron no fish). -यन्त्रम् a kind of retort. -व्रतम् 'crane-like conduct', hypocrisy; ये बकव्रतिनो विप्राः
; see also 196 (बकव्रतचर). -सहवासिन् a lotus flower; Kuval.
बकबकाय [bakabakāya], Den. Ā. To croak.
बकाची [bakācī], A kind of fish.
बकाय [bakāya], Denom. P. To act like बक.
बकुर [bakura], a. Horrible.
रः Lightning; thunderbolt.
A wind instrument used in battle; अभि दस्युं बकुरेणा धमन्ता Ṛ.v.1.117.21. (Naighaṇtuka gives the first meaning.)

बकुलः [bakulḥ], 1 A kind of tree, Mimusops Elengi, (said according to the convention of poets to put forth blossoms when sprinkled by young women with monthfuls of wine); काङ्क्षत्यन्यो (केसरः or बकुलः) वदनमदिरां दोहदच्छद्यना$स्याः
Me.8
; बकुलः सीधुगण्डूषसेकात् (विकसति); तव निश्वसितानुकारिभिर्बकुलैरर्धचितां समं मया
; (for similar conventions about other trees see the quotation under अशोक).
a kind of drug. -लम् The fragrant flower of this tree; कृती मालाकरो बकुलमपि कुत्रापि निदधे
. -ली A kind of drug.
बकूलः [bakūlḥ], The Bakula tree.
बकेरुका [bakērukā], 1 A small crane.
The branch of a tree bent by the wind.
बकोटः [bakōṭḥ], A crane.
बाकुलम् [bākulam], The fruit of the Bakula tree.
